title: PAR-144 ACAD_LAYOUT dictionary membership fast slice

localScope.head: de27a33
localScope.worktreeState: Broadly modified and uncommitted; no files staged.
localScope.change: The existing two-layout generated selector now captures the emitted ACAD_LAYOUT dictionary and independently decodes its bounded frame, versioned object-data/string-stream boundary, exact name keys, ordered child-handle tokens, and dictionary parent handle. Each key/child handle resolves to the corresponding captured LAYOUT frame, and each LAYOUT parent token resolves back to the dictionary. Frame CRC and sentinel adjacency are checked. AC1015/AC1018 use inline name strings; AC1021/AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 use the detached string stream. Common-prefix self/null handles are intentionally excluded from child-token comparison.

evidenceCeiling: Generated writer bytes plus test-local bounded frame/token/string decoders and writer receipts. This validates internal serialized graph structure across six target versions only; it is not an independent DWG reader, a third-party producer artifact, native CAD acceptance, or general multi-layout qualification.

implementationReadiness.existingOwner: PAR-144 under the existing 7G.3 layout graph/DWG writer owner ledger
implementationReadiness.completedSlice: Generated ACAD_LAYOUT dictionary name-to-child-handle membership, reciprocal LAYOUT parent tokens, frame CRC/extent, and following sentinel boundaries for the two-layout selector.
implementationReadiness.nextLocalSlice: Self-unblock to the next dependency-ready local PAR-07/S3.7c invariant in the existing implementation queue. Keep independent DWG reader and native CAD qualification at their composed checkpoints.
